name: Cover 2 Roll to Cover 3 Sky vs Trips
formation: Tampa Shell vs Gun Trips Right (3x1)

summary.motive: Answer a trips overload by rotating out of the baited two-high shell into three-deep coverage, trading one deep half for a middle-third eraser without weakening the flood side.
summary.keyDefender: FS spinning from his weak half to the deep middle third — the rotation that turns a flood beater into a contested throw
summary.whyItWorks: The offense keys the frozen two-safety picture and attacks the strength half, but the sky rotation has already replaced it with a sinking corner over the corner route.
summary.failureMode: Late motion that flips the strength call after the rotation, stranding the rolling safety on the wrong side of the new flood.

beats.title: 1. The Two-High Trips Shell
beats.text: Tampa 2 halves are shown to a trips formation — the exact picture offenses tag as a flood beater, with both safeties frozen deep.

beats.title: 2. Sky Rotation Away From the Weak Side
beats.text: At the snap the free safety spins to the deep middle third while the strong safety sprints down to the flat — corners sink over the top into thirds.

beats.title: 3. Flood Into Rotated Threes
beats.text: The trips flood climbs exactly on schedule, but the corner route now rises into a deep third that did not exist before the snap, with MIKE closing the intermediate wall.

beats.title: 4. Broken Up Over the Top
beats.text: The sinking RCB arrives with the rotating FS bracketing behind — the flood finisher is swatted loose at its highest point.

relations.tell: The free safety starts drifting toward the hash mid-cadence while the strong safety tilts flat-side — base Tampa 2 keeps both safeties perfectly still until the snap.
